title: Rebuilt routing and evidence handoffs around Plan V2
points: Router plans now carry typed evidence products, coverage policy, result requirements, compute parameters, session scope, and selector dependencies from one contract registry shared by routing, lanes, compute, and Analyst instructions.
The live Router prompt is smaller and no longer assembles the legacy rules, examples, router-ask, or analysis-intent packs.
Segment and subsidiary breakdowns now prioritize the complete disclosed segment schedule, including all panels and requested profit, depreciation, asset, or capital-expenditure rows.
Database-wide filing inventories use a typed report-inventory product, while exact filing-note tables use a typed numeric-note product with required category labels that retrieval must preserve.
Narrative retrieval now accumulates a bounded candidate inventory across recovery searches, so finding a missing company cannot erase useful pages already retrieved for the rest of the comparison.
Open market-wide statement screens run through the ordinary typed lane contract; the legacy phrase-specific deterministic-surface switch and redundant market-topic validation were removed.

Deterministic compute stages consume typed parameters instead of recognizing limits, horizons, thresholds, or arithmetic from query wording, and model builds continue with every usable annual period available.

Runtime no longer infers follow-up scope, report lookup, company overview, workspace actions, or compute parameters from query-text shortcuts; one bounded recovery module remains only for otherwise empty plans.
